subtitle: Meeting notes your AI writes up from rough notes or transcripts.
about: A note with meeting summaries, decisions and an action checklist with owners and due dates. Give your AI rough notes or a transcript to write it up, then tick off tasks yourself or in chat.

ask.prompt: Set up the meeting notes template in my Pinto Notes.

slides.label: Write up a meeting
slides.you: Here are my notes from this week's two meetings.
slides.ai: Both are under Meetings now, with what was decided. Three action items have a name and a date.
slides.alt: Meeting notes filled in, in Pinto Notes on a Mac

slides.label: Tick an action
slides.ai: Ticked it off under Action items.

slides.label: Use it yourself
slides.note: Or tick and edit it yourself.
